metadata.title: Norm MacDonald SNL

reviews.reviewbody: He couldn't remember his lines for sh*t

So far, the only clip I've noticed is missing is Norm's appearance during the Weekend Update portion of the 25th Anniversary special (which uploaded in the Archive in a separate location). [There's a picture of Norm, Chevy Chase, and Colin Quinn doing a Weekend Update segment that was used a lot after Norm died, but that was from 2012 Comedy Awards held in New York on April 28, 2012. ]

Much thanks to the uploader since I've heard that when NBC has made old episodes of SNL available, they are often missing the Weekend Update segment.

The outpouring of love from generations past and present is a beautiful thing to see. I only wish Norm was here to bathe in this love. I feel he may have felt quite alone at times.
Thank you for posting these gems for his fans to enjoy. You will live on through websites like this one and through folks who get who you are. We love you Norm.
You are a legend for cataloging this thank you so much.
